title: Boston Freedom Trail Private Car Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

Total Time of 4 hours includes time outside some venues, time getting back to the parked vehicle to drive to the next stop. Times can be altered, depending on your interests. We can also make special requests for substitutions of points of interest.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We'll see the sights on Boston's Freedom Trail and get a closer look by leaving the car and walking inside some locations (depends on day and hours of operation for some sites). We'll have time to go aboard the USS Constitution (closed Mondays). A close-up experience in the oldest neighborhoods of the North End, Beacon Hill, School Street, and Charlestown. Look at places of events and the people from different periods of the settlement of Boston, and the American Revolution. If weather isn't favorable, we can revise the walking portions according to your wishes. A favorite stop is Faneuil Hall, the Great Hall Meeting Room and the Ancient and Honorable Artillery Company Museum (hours vary).
